name: vent-brush
draw: A hairbrush seen from the front whose oval head is pierced by rows of open slots between short bristle rows, with a straight handle.

name: edge-brush
draw: A small slim double-ended tool: a tiny bristle brush at one end and a fine-tooth comb at the other, drawn diagonally.

name: hair-crimper
draw: A hinged styling iron with two long flat plates opened slightly, the plate faces showing zigzag ridges, and a cord from the handle.

name: hair-bonnet
draw: A puffy round sleep bonnet seen from the side with a gathered elastic band along the lower edge, shaped like a large soft shower cap.

name: sectioning-clip
draw: A long narrow duckbill hair clip seen from the side, jaws closed to a point and a spring hinge bump near the back.

name: banana-clip
draw: A long curved comb clip shaped like a banana, hinged at the bottom, with interlocking teeth along both inner edges.

name: hair-fork
draw: A U-shaped two-prong hair pin with long straight tines and a decorative rounded top, drawn vertically.

name: hair-donut
draw: A thick ring of mesh sponge seen at an angle, like a doughnut, used to shape a bun, with a light dotted texture.

name: neck-duster
draw: A barber neck duster: a round fat brush of soft bristles fanning from a short wooden handle.

name: tint-bowl
draw: A shallow hair colour mixing bowl with a grip rim, and a flat tint brush with a pointed tail handle resting across it.

name: hair-foils
draw: Head seen from the side with several folded foil packets lying in layers across the hair, each a small rectangle.

name: highlighting-cap
draw: A head wearing a snug cap dotted with small holes, with a few strands pulled through and a hook tool beside it.

name: color-swatch-ring
draw: A fan of hair colour swatch strands hanging from a single ring, each strand a tapered lock with a small tag.

name: hair-color-applicator-bottle
draw: A squeeze bottle with measurement lines on its side and a long tapered nozzle cap, used to apply hair dye.

name: clipper-guard
draw: A clip-on clipper guard comb seen from the side: a comb-toothed plastic attachment with a curved spine and a number tab.

name: razor-strop
draw: A long leather strap hanging from a hook at the top, with a handle at the bottom end and a straight razor laid against it.

name: shaving-stand
draw: A small stand with a pedestal base holding a shaving brush hanging bristles down and a razor hanging beside it.

name: beard-shaping-tool
draw: A flat plastic template comb with curved outer edges matching a beard line and a row of teeth along one side.

name: beard-bib
draw: A cape-like apron stretched under a chin with two suction cups at its upper corners stuck to a mirror edge, catching trimmed hair.

name: comb-disinfectant-jar
draw: A tall cylindrical glass jar filled with liquid and a lid, with two combs standing submerged inside.

name: shears-holster
draw: A leather holster pouch with two slots, one holding hair shears with finger rings sticking out and one holding a comb.

name: hair-mousse
draw: An aerosol can with a nozzle cap and a round cloud of foam sitting beside the nozzle.

name: pressing-comb
draw: A metal hot comb with a row of wide teeth on a solid metal body and a wooden handle, with small heat waves above.

name: hair-twist-sponge
draw: A rectangular sponge pad covered in a grid of round holes, pressed against a patch of coiled hair.

name: peineta-comb
draw: A tall ornamental hair comb with an arched lacy crown and short teeth at the bottom, worn upright behind a bun.

name: hair-perm
draw: Head seen from the side with rows of small cylindrical perm rods wound tight across the hair.

name: hair-clippings
draw: A small pile of cut hair locks on the floor with a pair of scissors lying next to it.

name: hair-transplant
draw: The top of a bald head seen from above with a neat grid of tiny dots of implanted hair across the front.

name: uv-sterilizer-cabinet
draw: A small cabinet with a glass door showing tools on a shelf, lit by a tube lamp inside with short rays.

name: towel-warmer-cabinet
draw: A small box cabinet with a front door opened to show rolled towels stacked inside and wavy steam lines above.

name: rolling-stool
draw: A round padded stool seen from the side on a single gas lift column with a five-caster wheel base.

name: salon-styling-chair
draw: A salon chair with a rounded back, armrests, a hydraulic column on a wide round base and a foot pump pedal.

name: salon-trolley
draw: A narrow rolling cart with three stacked trays holding brushes, clips and a spray bottle, on small wheels.

name: styling-station
draw: A wall mirror above a narrow counter shelf holding a dryer and brushes, with a salon chair back in front.

name: magnifying-lamp
draw: A round ring lamp with a large magnifying lens in the middle, on a jointed arm with a clamp base.

name: bob-haircut
draw: Head and shoulders in front view with straight chin-length hair cut level all around, framing the face.

name: pixie-cut
draw: Head in three-quarter view with very short cropped hair and a small side-swept fringe over the forehead.

name: buzz-cut
draw: Head in front view with hair clipped very short and even, shown as a thin textured cap close to the scalp.

name: undercut-hairstyle
draw: Head in side view with long hair on top swept back and the side and back shaved short below a sharp line.

name: mohawk-hairstyle
draw: Head in side view with shaved sides and a tall strip of spiked hair running from forehead to nape.

name: pompadour
draw: Head in side view with hair swept up high and back from the forehead in a big rolled wave, short at the sides.

name: mullet
draw: Head in side view with short hair on top and sides and long hair hanging down over the back of the neck.

name: man-bun
draw: Head in side view with hair pulled back tight and gathered into a round bun at the back of the crown, with a short beard.

name: space-buns
draw: Head in front view with two round buns sitting high on either side of the top of the head.

name: pigtails
draw: Head in front view with hair parted in the middle and tied into two bunches sticking out low on each side.

name: french-braid
draw: Back of a head showing a single braid woven close to the scalp from the crown, then hanging down in a plait.

name: cornrows
draw: Top of a head seen from above with several parallel tight braids running from forehead to nape in neat rows.

name: dreadlocks
draw: Head in front view with long rope-like locks hanging down past the shoulders, each lock a separate thick strand.

name: afro-hairstyle
draw: Head in front view with a large rounded halo of textured hair around the face and above the head.

name: bangs-hairstyle
draw: Head in front view with straight hair and a blunt fringe cut straight across the forehead above the eyebrows.

name: side-part-hairstyle
draw: Head in front view with short neat hair divided by a clear parting line on one side and combed across.

name: slicked-back-hair
draw: Head in side view with hair combed flat straight back from the forehead in smooth parallel lines.

name: bald-head
draw: Head and shoulders in front view with a smooth fully bald scalp and a small highlight shine on top.

name: comb-over
draw: Head in front view with a thin layer of long strands combed from one side across a bald crown.

name: beehive-hairdo
draw: Head in side view with hair piled into a tall rounded cone on top, like a beehive, smooth at the sides.

name: french-twist
draw: Back of a head showing hair twisted into a vertical roll up the middle, tucked in, with a pin at the top.

name: box-braids
draw: Head in front view with many long thin square-parted braids hanging straight down past the shoulders.

name: bantu-knots
draw: Head in front view with several small coiled knots spaced evenly across the scalp in a grid.

name: half-up-half-down
draw: Back of a head with the upper section tied into a small bun or ponytail and the rest of the hair hanging loose below.

name: flat-top-haircut
draw: Head in front view with short sides and hair on top standing up to a perfectly flat level surface.

name: fade-haircut
draw: Head in side view with short hair on top that shades down to bare skin at the sides, shown by a dotted gradient.

name: spiky-hair
draw: Head in front view with short hair styled into many sharp upward spikes across the top.

name: finger-waves
draw: Head in side view with short hair set into flat S-shaped ridged waves running across the head, 1920s style.

name: victory-rolls
draw: Head in front view with two large rolled curls sitting on top at the front on either side of the part, 1940s style.

name: bowl-cut
draw: Head in front view with hair cut in an even rounded cap, straight fringe over the forehead and level all around like an upturned bowl.

name: pencil-mustache
draw: Lower face showing a very thin narrow line mustache just above the upper lip, with a small gap in the middle.

name: walrus-mustache
draw: Lower face with a thick bushy mustache that droops down and covers the whole upper lip and the mouth corners.

name: horseshoe-mustache
draw: Lower face with a mustache running down both sides of the mouth to the jawline in an upside-down U shape.

name: sideburns
draw: Face in front view with thick wide sideburns running down the cheeks from the ears to the jaw, chin shaved.

name: chin-strap-beard
draw: Face in front view with a thin line of beard following the jawline from ear to ear under the chin, no mustache.

name: soul-patch
draw: Lower face with a small tuft of hair just below the lower lip and nothing else.

name: van-dyke-beard
draw: Lower face with a separate upturned mustache and a pointed goatee beard on the chin, cheeks bare.

name: french-manicure
draw: A fingertip with a long nail whose tip is marked by a curved white band across the free edge.

name: nail-drill
draw: A slim electric nail file handpiece like a pen with a small drill bit at the tip and a cord from the back.

name: dappen-dish
draw: A small glass dish with a lid on a thick base holding acrylic liquid, with a nail brush resting on its rim.

name: nail-dust-collector
draw: A flat low box with a grille on top where a hand rests, and a small fan inside drawn through the vents.

name: manicure-bowl
draw: A small curved bowl shaped for fingertips, with a hand dipping four fingers into water in it.

name: pedicure-chair
draw: A large padded throne-like chair with armrests and a round foot basin built into the base in front.

name: nail-swatch-wheel
draw: A circular display wheel with false nail tips arranged radially around its edge, each tip a small painted nail.

name: dotting-tool
draw: A slim double-ended stick with a small metal ball at each end, a dot of polish next to one end.
